AGEasy, we achieved a net revenue of INR23 crores in Q4 FY26, showing a 1.4x Y -on-Y growth and 1.2x on a quarter basis.
The FY26 revenue stands at approximately INR77 crores, marking a 100% Y -on-Y growth over last year.
Growth & demand: The company reported a quarterly revenue of INR72 crores in Q4, reflecting a Q-on-Q growth of 45% against a revenue of INR49.8 crores in Q3 FY '26 and a year-on-year growth of 58% against a revenue of INR45.5 crores in Q4 FY '25.
Otherwise, if you look at the beds which are already operational, they have shown a growth of 10% on a quarter-on-quarter basis.
We also launched 19 new products in FY26, out of which 65% are delivering a gross margin of 50% and above.
Margins & costs: As far as the cost is concerned, sir, approximately 15% is the variable cost, which comes as a direct variable cost for such management fee, which is our payroll cost, which is our additional manpower and additional expenses what we do for each project.
And takes about 8 to 10 quarters to reach about 65%- 70%, when it starts producing a contribution margin at unit level of 30% plus and an EBITDA margin of 16% to 18%.
On the Care Home side, we have always said that it's a 32% plus contribution margin per care home at maturity and a 16% to 18% EBITDA margin at maturity for each care home .
Capex & expansion: Finally, we have a total bed capacity of 485 beds in 8 care homes across NCR, Bengaluru and Chennai.
What kind of management revenue do we expect after the projects are commissioned, E360, E361.
But after the projects are commissioned, we can expect an annuity of about INR10-15 crores per project.
